baseline.gap: Synchronous creation/listen during deployment listener replenishment could block all reactor clients; setup failure could invoke synchronous socket Drop.

implementation.owner: OpeningSocket retains accepted creation and original connection borrow until checked scalar positive adoption or terminal negative rejection. The same listener owner retains known socket and moved setup pending call through listen/accept.
implementation.readiness: Bind every accepted phase to the same CQ; bounded rotating turns and earliest remaining setup/input/controller/output/close deadline. Idle admitted accept has no timer. One fixed four-position pool across all phases.
implementation.deadline: Original five-second monotonic setup budget before reservation/submission, preserved through creation/listen/accept admission and binding. Only rejected queue-full submission permits 50ms bounded phase backoff. Confirmed rejection/unstarted failure backs off replenishment.
implementation.cleanup: Known rejected setup sockets move into existing CQ close owners. Binding/malformed/uncertain observation/deadline/incomplete Drop retains complete owner through domain abort, never accepted replay or scalar cleanup reconstruction. Returned attachments use existing runtime disposal. Guard-free userspace; same C18, no new root/pin/registry/family/custody or physical release/refund proof.
implementation.shutdown: Stop replenishment; retain accepted creation/listen under original budget, then transfer known sockets to close without further setup. Cancel idle accept pending before moving its socket. Drain close owners under original deadlines while other phases stay live. Whole parent shutdown and syscall latency remain unqualified.
